subject: Re: IME status: decision - IME_WW recommended for the pilot
body:
All,

Decision for the July 27 close: we recommend IME_WW - the fully interpretable variant with linear assignment - for the internal forecasting pilot. On the internal-workload eval it finished within 1.5% RMSE of IME_BW (the clean-regime story held), and a linear assignment module means the whole prediction path is explainable, which is the actual product requirement. IME_BW goes in the memo as the fallback if pilot accuracy disappoints.

Flap-rate ships as a first-class metric next to RMSE, with the smoothness_hp=0.01 guidance baked into the default config. Efe was right to push on this - an explanation that changes every timestep is worse than none.

Jelena - please make sure Amara's synthetic-generation pipeline gets documented and kept; dialing regime overlap to find the failure boundary is a trick the whole portfolio should steal.

Pilot kickoff with the capacity-planning team targeted for August.

Dmitri
